lines.text: My old school photos are so cringe.

data.define: Used for something so awkward or embarrassing it's hard to watch.

example.text: My old school photos are so cringe.

misuse.text: Don't call a friend's heartfelt gift 'cringe'.

publish.title: What does "cringe" mean?
publish.value: Cringe = So bad it feels uncomfortable. Example: "My old school photos are so cringe." (very casual English, US).
